page_title: HAV 1-3 NIC | Le Havre v Nice 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' 1 - 3 Goal! Jeremie Boga provides Sofiane Diop (Nice) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:3.
90+3' The ball goes out of play. Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Melvin Bard (Nice) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Pablo Rosario (Nice) on for Mohamed-Ali Cho.
87' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
86' Ilyes Housni (Le Havre) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
85' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
84' The ball goes behind for a corner. Le Havre will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' Le Havre have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
81' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) replacing Yassine Kechta.
81' Here is a change. Antoine Joujou is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Ilyes Housni (Le Havre).
81' Substitution. Gaetan Laborde did his best and is replaced by Jeremie Boga (Nice).
79' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
76' Nice concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
75' Half-chance! Evann Guessand (Nice) plays a pass into the box, but Mathieu Gorgelin reacts well to snuff out the attack.
74' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) serves up a nice cross, but Mathieu Gorgelin punches the ball away.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andre Ayew (Le Havre) comes onto the pitch for Ahmed Hassan.
70' Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.
67' The current number of corner kicks is 2:2.
65' The ball is out of play. Nice win a corner kick.
65' The goal by Nice is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
64' The Nice players halt their celebrations as referee Stephanie Frappart makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
63' Goal! Evann Guessand (Nice) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:2.
62' Here's the change. Tom Louchet leaves the pitch and Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
61' Evann Guessand (Nice) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Le Havre are awarded a free kick.
61' Today's match ends for Ali Abdi who will be replaced by Sofiane Diop (Nice).
58' Loic Nego (Le Havre) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
56' Loic Nego (Le Havre) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
54' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mathieu Gorgelin intercepts the ball.
54' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
53' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
51' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Stephanie Frappart who sees an offensive foul. Nice will take a free kick.
50' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
48' Evann Guessand (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' The game has come to an end for Mahamadou Diawara. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+1' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' The game is interrupted. Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
44' A player from Nice commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. A free kick to Le Havre.
42' Flag goes up against Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

41' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Mathieu Gorgelin!
39' Melvin Bard (Nice) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the left post.
37' Evann Guessand (Nice) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mathieu Gorgelin, who smothers the ball.
36' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
35' Le Havre are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
34' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Melvin Bard (Nice) is given a yellow card.
34' Loic Nego (Le Havre) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
33' Moise Bombito (Nice) commits a rough foul. Stephanie Frappart stops the game and makes a call. Le Havre get a free kick.
32' Melvin Bard (Nice) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
31' A precise low pass is received by Gaetan Laborde (Nice), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
28' 1 - 2 Goal! Mahamadou Diawara plays a short, square pass into the path of Yassine Kechta (Le Havre), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 1:2. Fabulous goal!
28' Loic Nego (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
26' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
26' A clumsy foul by Ali Abdi (Nice) and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle.
25' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
24' Wonderful movement by Le Havre. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

23' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar.
23' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
22' Evann Guessand (Nice) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
21' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
20' One of the players from Le Havre times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
18' 0 - 2 Own goal! Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 0:2.
16' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Gaetan Laborde (Nice) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Evann Guessand provided an assist for the goal.
16' Melvin Bard (Nice) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
15' Loic Nego (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but Marcin Bulka comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
14' Le Havre are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
12' The ball is cleared after Evann Guessand (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
10' Le Havre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Loic Nego (Le Havre). The linesman makes the right call and Le Havre will have a corner.
8' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) picks up a long through ball, but Mathieu Gorgelin deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
5' Loic Nego (Le Havre) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
4' Baptiste Santamaria (Nice) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
1' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Le Havre will kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart will supervise the game today.
